description: Defines the QuicStreamIdManager class responsible for managing stream IDs in the QUIC protocol, including stream state, flow control, and related operations.

classes.name: QuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages stream IDs for IETF QUIC, handling stream creation, closure, flow control, and communication with peer.

classes.name: QuicStreamIdManager::DelegateInterface
classes.description: Interface for delegate to send MAX_STREAMS frames and interact with the session.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current state of the stream ID manager.

methods.name: OnStreamsBlockedFrame
methods.description: Processes a STREAMS_BLOCKED frame; returns false if an error occurs.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingStream
methods.description: Checks if the next outgoing stream ID can be allocated.

methods.name: SendMaxStreamsFrame
methods.description: Generates and sends a MAX_STREAMS frame.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure, updating internal state and possibly sending MAX_STREAMS.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next stream ID to be used for outgoing streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming streams allowed.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingStreams
methods.description: Determines if new outgoing streams can be created based on current limits.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Checks if a given stream ID exceeds the limit and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available for use.

methods.name: incoming_initial_max_open_streams
methods.description: Returns the initial maximum number of open incoming streams.

methods.name: next_outgoing_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the ID for the next outgoing stream.

methods.name: available_incoming_streams
methods.description: Returns the number of incoming streams the peer can still create.

methods.name: largest_peer_created_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the largest stream ID created by the peer.

methods.name: outgoing_max_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outgoing streams allowed.

methods.name: incoming_actual_max_streams
methods.description: Returns the actual maximum number of incoming streams.

methods.name: incoming_advertised_max_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of incoming streams advertised to the peer.

methods.name: outgoing_stream_count
methods.description: Returns the count of outgoing streams.
